cohort: Placental samples were collected from patients diagnosed with preeclampsia and healthy control patients.
finding: The study found significant alterations in the m6A methylome and mRNA expression profiles in preeclamptic placentas compared to controls, including up-regulation of METTL3 and METTL14, differential m6A peaks linked to metabolic and signaling pathways, and m6A-regulated HSPA1A expression.
